text:
Predicates:
Appropriate(x) ::: x is appropriate for people of all ages.
Watch(x) ::: x can be watched by children without guidance from parents.
EroticViolent(x) ::: x contains excessive erotic and violent content.
RatedGeneralAudience(x) ::: x is rated General Audience.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) ::: x is a family-friendly animated film.
MovieInFrozenSeries(x) ::: x is a movie in the Frozen series.
Premises:
∀x (Appropriate(x) → Watch(x)) ::: If a film is appropriate for people of all ages, then children can watch it without guidance from parents.
∀x (EroticViolent(x) → ¬Watch(x)) ::: If a film contains excessive erotic and violent content, children cannot watch it without guidance from their parents.
∀x (RatedGeneralAudience(x) → Appropriate(x)) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, then it is appropriate for people of all ages.
∀x (FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x) → RatedGeneralAudience(x)) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
∀x (MovieInFrozenSeries(x) → FamilyFriendlyAnimated(x)) ::: All movies in the Frozen series are family-friendly animated films.
FamilyFriendlyAnimated(hachi) ∨ Appropriate(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either a family-friendly animated film or is appropriate for people of all ages.
Conclusion:
RatedGeneralAudience(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is rated General Audience.
